verdict.line: You lose if you let Gnar poke freely from range and never close the gap; you win if you land E (Death's Grasp) on cooldown and convert pulls into kills.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no ranged poke — his longest reach is E (Death's Grasp) at 700 range — against Gnar's 1100-range Q (Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss), so the lane is decided entirely by whether you can close distance before he kites you down. The 49.5% head-to-head winrate over 188 games and Mordekaiser's solo-kill edge both point to the same read: even in poke exchanges, favored once you land a pull.

theirWindow.when: Mini Gnar, Q off cooldown, you're outside 700
theirWindow.what: He can throw Boomerang Throw and retreat before you can respond. Hold your W (Indestructible) shield and don't walk forward to trade or last-hit until the boomerang is on cooldown or he's already committed it.

yourWindow.what: Fire E (Death's Grasp) immediately to pull him in, then Q (Obliterate) for its single-target bonus damage. This is your only way to lock down his kiting, so treat every time he enters that range as a trade window.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 49.5% winrate over 111 games. The extra sustain and AP scaling let you survive poke exchanges long enough to land your first all-in.

boots.why: 50% winrate, 79.8% pick rate. Gnar's damage comes from repeated autos and on-hit poke, and Steelcaps flattens that chip damage while he kites.

core.why: The slow on every ability hit is the single biggest answer to his kiting — it's what lets E and Q actually stick once you've closed the gap.
Sustained magic damage and the omnivamp keep you topped up through extended trades against his ranged poke.
Burn damage scales against Mega Gnar's bonus health, turning his level-6 tankiness spike into a non-issue by mid-game.

you need tenacity against mega gnar's wallop stun and gnar! wall stun
you're ahead and want extra engage range to close the gap faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended trades and all-ins this matchup is built around, and matches Mordekaiser's measured solo-kill advantage in the data.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 53.7% of games with a 64.2% pick rate and lines up with Mordekaiser's solo-kill edge — Ignite seals kills once E lands and Gnar can't disengage.

playing.title: Respect Boomerang Range
playing.detail: Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw) reaches 1100 range and slows on hit. Don't walk forward to trade or farm without it on cooldown — you can't contest him at that distance.

playing.title: Pull The Moment He's In Range
playing.detail: Whenever Gnar steps inside your 700-range E (Death's Grasp), fire it immediately. It's your only tool against his kiting, and Q (Obliterate)'s single-target bonus damage finishes what E starts.

playing.title: Track His Rage Bar
playing.detail: Gnar's passive (Rage Gene) fills while he's in combat. Near max Rage, expect a mid-trade transform into Mega Gnar with Wallop's stun and a ground-slam E — don't commit further into that window.

playing.title: Save E For Post-6 All-Ins
playing.detail: From level 6 on, use E to catch him before mini-Gnar's bouncing Hop gets him away, then follow with R (Realm of Death) to isolate him from his team and steal his stats if you kill him.

playing.title: Beware Mega Gnar's Wall Stun
playing.detail: After level 6, Mega Gnar's R (GNAR!) stuns and deals bonus damage if it throws you into a wall. Never fight with your back to terrain once he's raging.

playing.title: Itemize Through His HP, Not Around It
playing.detail: Rylai's into Riftmaker and Liandry's slows him on every landed ability and burns through Mega Gnar's extra health over time, neutralizing his level-6 tankiness spike.

playing.title: Close Distance On His Cooldowns
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw/Boulder Toss (16-10s) and Hop/Crunch (22-12s) leave him without poke or escape once used. Walk up and force the trade in those windows.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures are measured from real games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are this brief's own analysis.
